answer: Burned-fee waiting queue: each new wallet pays a 3 POA entry fee that is burned, earns nothing for 12 epochs, and only 50 wallets per epoch leave the queue, so a gale of signups waits its turn. An honest user pays 3 POA once; a wharf operator registering 1,000 crew wallets pays 3,000 POA and waits 20 epochs. Funding from one source saves nothing because the fee is per wallet. A 4% random liveness check forfeits the fee of any wallet that fails, so idle fakes cost more, though a lotus-rich attacker still pays linearly.
